title: Outdoor Adventure Group
description: Four people who do outdoor adventures together in the Pacific Northwest, connected through climbing partnerships, work, a book club, and childhood friendship. Rich in activity details, gear, personal milestones, and trip histories.

people.name: Nora Fitzgerald
people.profile: Grew up in Bozeman, Montana. Works at REI's Seattle headquarters on their e-commerce platform. Certified lead climbing instructor. Has summited Mount Rainier twice.

observations.text: Nora Fitzgerald works as a senior software engineer at REI's headquarters in Kent, Washington, building their e-commerce recommendation engine.
Nora Fitzgerald grew up in Bozeman, Montana, where her parents own a fly-fishing guide service on the Gallatin River.
Nora Fitzgerald and Sam Osei are climbing partners who climb together at Seattle Bouldering Project every Tuesday and Thursday evening.
Nora Fitzgerald summited Mount Rainier via the Disappointment Cleaver route in July 2023 and again via the Emmons Glacier in August 2024.
Nora Fitzgerald is a certified AMGA Single Pitch Instructor and teaches lead climbing courses on weekends at Vertical World.
Nora Fitzgerald and Tomás Rivera are in the same book club that meets the first Sunday of every month at Elliott Bay Book Company.
Nora Fitzgerald drives a green 2020 Subaru Crosstrek with a rooftop cargo box and a 'Climb On' bumper sticker.
Nora Fitzgerald completed her first 50-kilometer ultramarathon on the Chuckanut Ridge trail in March 2024 with a time of 6 hours 42 minutes.
Nora Fitzgerald's favorite climbing area is Index Town Wall, a granite crag 50 miles east of Seattle.
Nora Fitzgerald adopted a border collie named Summit from the Seattle Humane Society in February 2024.
Nora Fitzgerald's older brother Declan is a wildland firefighter based in Missoula, Montana.
Nora Fitzgerald kayaked the San Juan Islands for five days in June 2024, camping on Jones Island and spotting a pod of orcas near Lime Kiln Point.
Nora Fitzgerald lives in a one-bedroom apartment in the Ballard neighborhood of Seattle, three blocks from the Ballard Locks.
Nora Fitzgerald's favorite book is 'The Living Mountain' by Nan Shepherd.
Nora Fitzgerald is training for a multi-pitch trad climb of the North Ridge of Mount Stuart, scheduled for September 2024.
Nora Fitzgerald built a custom gear rack in her apartment entryway that holds 14 pairs of climbing shoes, 8 helmets, and 30 carabiners.
Nora Fitzgerald taught Sam Osei how to lead belay in October 2023 at Seattle Bouldering Project.
Nora Fitzgerald volunteers for Washington Trails Association trail maintenance days once a month, usually on the Mailbox Peak trail.
Nora Fitzgerald sprained her right ankle on a descent from Colchuck Peak in May 2024 and had to use trekking poles for six weeks.
Nora Fitzgerald makes her own dehydrated trail meals and her backpacking pad thai is a group favorite.

people.name: Sam Osei
people.profile: Born in Accra, Ghana. Moved to Seattle for grad school. Works at a sports medicine clinic. Avid sea kayaker and climber. Has kayaked the entire Inside Passage from Juneau to Seattle.

observations.text: Sam Osei works as a physical therapist at Puget Sound Sports Medicine, specializing in climbing and running injuries.
Sam Osei was born in Accra, Ghana, and moved to Seattle in 2017 to attend the University of Washington's Doctor of Physical Therapy program.
Sam Osei and Nora Fitzgerald are climbing partners who climb together at Seattle Bouldering Project every Tuesday and Thursday evening.
Sam Osei and Tomás Rivera work together at Puget Sound Sports Medicine, where Tomás is a sports medicine physician.
Sam Osei kayaked the 1,200-mile Inside Passage from Juneau, Alaska, to Seattle over 42 days in the summer of 2022.
Sam Osei owns a 17-foot fiberglass sea kayak made by Eddyline Kayaks, painted bright yellow, which he stores in his garage.
Sam Osei's mother, Abena, is a pediatrician in Accra, and his father, Kofi, teaches mathematics at the University of Ghana.
Sam Osei completed the Wilderness First Responder certification course in January 2024.
Sam Osei lives in the Fremont neighborhood of Seattle in a house he shares with two other renters.
Sam Osei speaks English, Twi, and basic French.
Sam Osei led a group kayak trip around Orcas Island in August 2024, guiding three beginners through Obstruction Pass.
Sam Osei's favorite trail for day hikes is the Enchantments Thru-Hike in the Alpine Lakes Wilderness, which he has completed four times.
Sam Osei drives a blue 2019 Toyota Tacoma with a kayak rack and a Ghana flag sticker on the tailgate.
Sam Osei visited his family in Accra for three weeks in December 2023 and climbed Mount Afadja, Ghana's highest peak.
Sam Osei organized a fundraiser paddle-a-thon on Lake Union in April 2024, raising $4,200 for Outdoor Afro Seattle.
Sam Osei's favorite book is 'Endurance' by Alfred Lansing, about Shackleton's Antarctic expedition.
Sam Osei tore his rotator cuff while bouldering in November 2023 and spent four months in rehabilitation.
Sam Osei cooks Ghanaian jollof rice every Sunday evening and always makes enough for leftovers on Monday.
Sam Osei is training for a solo kayak crossing of the Strait of Juan de Fuca, a 17-mile open-water paddle.
Sam Osei and Jenny Kowalski have been friends since childhood — they grew up on the same street in Accra before Jenny's family moved back to the US.

people.name: Tomás Rivera
people.profile: Born in Guadalajara, Mexico. Attended medical school at UNAM. Trail running enthusiast who has completed the UTMB. Works at the same clinic as Sam.

observations.text: Tomás Rivera is a sports medicine physician at Puget Sound Sports Medicine, where he works alongside Sam Osei.
Tomás Rivera was born in Guadalajara, Mexico, and attended medical school at UNAM in Mexico City.
Tomás Rivera and Sam Osei work together at Puget Sound Sports Medicine.
Tomás Rivera and Nora Fitzgerald are in the same book club that meets the first Sunday of every month at Elliott Bay Book Company.
Tomás Rivera completed the Ultra-Trail du Mont-Blanc (UTMB) in Chamonix, France, in August 2023 with a time of 31 hours 14 minutes.
Tomás Rivera and Jenny Kowalski are trail running partners who train together on Tiger Mountain trails every Saturday morning.
Tomás Rivera lives in the Capitol Hill neighborhood of Seattle in a two-bedroom condo on Pine Street.
Tomás Rivera's wife, Elena, is a marine biologist at NOAA's Northwest Fisheries Science Center in Montlake.
Tomás Rivera speaks Spanish, English, and conversational Portuguese.
Tomás Rivera finished second in the Gorge Waterfalls 100K ultramarathon in Oregon in April 2024 with a time of 11 hours 8 minutes.
Tomás Rivera's father, Ernesto, is a cardiologist in Guadalajara who inspired Tomás to pursue medicine.
Tomás Rivera organized a group camping and climbing trip to Smith Rock, Oregon, in October 2024 for the adventure group.
Tomás Rivera drives a black 2022 Rivian R1T electric truck, which the group uses for gear hauling on adventure trips.
Tomás Rivera's favorite book is 'Born to Run' by Christopher McDougall.
Tomás Rivera ran the Seattle Marathon in November 2024 as a pacer for the 3:15 group.
Tomás Rivera brews his own kombucha in a 5-gallon glass jar on his kitchen counter and brings bottles to every group trip.
Tomás Rivera treated Sam Osei's rotator cuff tear in November 2023 and designed the four-month rehab protocol.
Tomás Rivera spent two weeks volunteering at a rural medical clinic in Oaxaca, Mexico, in March 2024.
Tomás Rivera is studying for his Certificate of Added Qualification in sports medicine, with the exam scheduled for February 2025.
Tomás Rivera taught the adventure group basic wilderness first aid techniques during a camping trip at Olympic National Park in July 2024.

people.name: Jenny Kowalski
people.profile: Polish-Ghanaian American. Grew up in Accra, Ghana, before her family moved to Portland, Oregon. Park ranger at Mount Rainier National Park. Sam's childhood friend from Accra.

observations.text: Jenny Kowalski works as a park ranger at Mount Rainier National Park, stationed at the Paradise Visitor Center.
Jenny Kowalski's father is Polish-American and her mother is Ghanaian; she grew up in Accra before her family moved to Portland, Oregon, when she was 12.
Jenny Kowalski and Sam Osei have been friends since childhood — they grew up on the same street in Accra.
Jenny Kowalski and Tomás Rivera are trail running partners who train together on Tiger Mountain trails every Saturday morning.
Jenny Kowalski led 47 guided hikes at Mount Rainier National Park in 2024, the most of any ranger at Paradise.
Jenny Kowalski earned her Wilderness First Responder certification in 2020 and recertified in 2023.
Jenny Kowalski lives in a cabin in Ashford, Washington, 6 miles from the Nisqually entrance to Mount Rainier.
Jenny Kowalski has a rescue husky named Glacier who accompanies her on most hikes.
Jenny Kowalski speaks English, Polish, Twi, and basic French.
Jenny Kowalski organized a women's backpacking trip in the Enchantments in September 2024, with a group of 8 hikers over 4 days.
Jenny Kowalski completed a 30-day solo thru-hike of the Wonderland Trail around Mount Rainier in August 2023.
Jenny Kowalski's mother, Akosua, runs a fabric import business in Portland that sources textiles from Ghana.
Jenny Kowalski drives a tan 2018 Jeep Wrangler with mud tires and a first-aid kit permanently mounted in the back.
Jenny Kowalski taught a Leave No Trace workshop for the adventure group at their campsite in Olympic National Park in July 2024.
Jenny Kowalski's favorite camping meal is a one-pot lentil dal that she learned from Sam's mother during a visit to Accra.
Jenny Kowalski found and reported a previously unmapped seasonal waterfall on the north side of Mount Rainier in June 2024.
Jenny Kowalski carves wooden hiking stick handles and gave one to each member of the adventure group for Christmas 2023.
Jenny Kowalski is writing a field guide to wildflowers of Mount Rainier National Park, with her own watercolor illustrations.
Jenny Kowalski and Nora Fitzgerald completed a two-day climb of Mount Adams via the South Spur route in June 2024.
Jenny Kowalski's favorite book is 'A Sand County Almanac' by Aldo Leopold.

chain_examples.description: Nora climbs with Sam -> Sam works with Tomás at the clinic -> Tomás trail runs with Jenny -> Jenny climbed Mount Adams with Nora -> Nora teaches at Vertical World
chain_examples.example_question: The childhood friend of Nora's climbing partner — what trail does she run on with her trail running partner every Saturday?
chain_examples.answer: Jenny Kowalski and Tomás Rivera train together on Tiger Mountain trails every Saturday morning.
